en: Colorized historic postcard view from a park with a wooden bench and trees in the foreground, looking toward a large multi‑winged barracks complex with red roofs and white walls in the distance. Overhead telegraph poles stand near an open field. Red German text at the top identifies the scene as a view of the barracks of the 3rd Battalion, 12th Infantry Regiment No. 177 in Freiberg in Saxony. At the bottom, small red text notes that it is a hand-colored artist postcard.
